scope_note: This record completes the first-pass identity and disposition audit of all 45 SVG assets in the current documentary asset namespace. It does not claim that every asset has received rendered domain review. Audit depth is stated per asset. Independent visual-semantic and domain-sensitive review remains blocking for the pilot.

audit_basis.rendered_visual_review: The SVG was rendered and visually inspected against its stated title, description, caption, and mathematical role.
audit_basis.svg_source_review: The SVG source and documentary context were inspected directly; visible semantics are recoverable from the source.
audit_basis.edition_context_and_asset_identity: The current page/edition role, asset identity, file class, and intended mathematical relation were audited. The disposition is a governed first-pass classification, not a substitute for independent rendered domain review.
audit_basis.decorative_hero_context: The cover is used as aria-hidden hero art and carries no mathematical teaching or authority role. It remains subject to ordinary aesthetic/accessibility review but is outside the concept-defining pilot plate set.

assets.reason: Decorative hero art is aria-hidden and does not carry the arithmetic claim.
The prime-count to Euler-factor to L-function chain is diagrammatic but should expose the actual local-to-global construction rather than rely on atmosphere.
The cubic and points can be mistaken for literal arithmetic data; the successor should plot E_5 exactly and bind verified rational points and the genuine area-5 triangle.
The theorem frontier should become an explicit status/rank-range map rather than an island metaphor carrying theorem boundaries implicitly.
The arithmetic and analytic ledgers need an explicit correspondence diagram with rank, point counts, Euler factors, central vanishing, and the conjectural bridge separately labeled.
The strong BSD leading-term factors require an exact normalized infographic; decorative balance alone is too weak for the number of theorem-critical factors.
The plate states the exact 252/105 repeated-subtraction trace, common-measure conclusion, and non-authority boundary; SVG is appropriate for this finite textual construction.
The three-column historical/bounded-modern/later-mathematics concordance is intrinsically diagrammatic and explicitly separates authority surfaces.
Decorative hero art carries no Hodge claim.
The current circle-arrow-H^(p,p) grammar is too content-poor to teach codimension, the cycle-class map, rationality, many-to-one behavior, or conjectural surjectivity.
The successor should make bidegrees, conjugation symmetry, total degree, and the relevant (p,p) locus explicit rather than depend on a decorative diamond motif.
The rational/projective boundary and the false integral/unrestricted-Kahler extensions should be displayed as explicit theorem/category boundaries.
The cohomology-as-memory metaphor needs a literal anchor showing cycles/classes and what information is retained or forgotten.
Nested solution-class distinctions are naturally diagrammatic; the SVG role is appropriate if labels preserve the exact inclusion/implication boundaries.
Decorative hero art carries no PDE evidence.
A velocity-everywhere lesson should visibly encode a spatial vector field and distinguish transport, pressure, viscosity, and incompressibility without implying a simulation.
The scaling-critical line, continuation criteria, partial regularity, and unresolved endpoint should be separated quantitatively rather than compressed into one generic frontier.
The closed-loop/line motif does not depict a three-dimensional vortex tube, stretching, thinning, vorticity magnitude, or an energy cascade despite the stated teaching role.
A method-barrier map is intrinsically diagrammatic and can remain SVG when each barrier is labeled as a limitation on technique rather than a theorem about P versus NP.
A reduction hub around SAT is naturally vectorial; exact reduction directions and problem classes remain the controlling semantics.
Decorative hero art carries no complexity-theoretic claim.
A directed mapping between decision problems is intrinsically diagrammatic and the manuscript supplies x in A iff f(x) in B; this is the primary SVG positive control.
The maze is explicitly introduced as metaphor for finding versus checking and does not masquerade as a machine-level proof object.
Decorative hero art carries no topology or Ricci-flow claim.
Finite extinction and reverse topological bookkeeping should be shown as an explicit staged event graph with factor elimination rather than compressed iconography.
A static distorted blob/grid and signal do not visibly encode Ricci-flow evolution, metric smoothing, curvature scale, or singularity formation.
The sphere/torus loop obstruction is explicitly labeled as a lower-dimensional analogy and is well matched to simple vector exposition.
The planar cut-and-wedge grammar risks teaching a two-dimensional operation rather than an S^2 x I neck, cuts along two-spheres, and attachment of standard caps.
Decorative hero art carries no assertion about zeta zeros.
The Euler-product plate should show prime-indexed local factors, the product relation, and the Re(s)>1 convergence boundary explicitly.
Finite verification, critical-line proportions, heuristics, and the universal quantifier should be separated with explicit scope rather than generic evidence icons.
The zero-to-prime fluctuation bridge needs an analytic encoding of a rho contribution, truncation/summation qualification, and the x^beta amplitude role.
The description promises trivial zeros, pole, symmetry, and nontrivial zeros, but the visible plate supplies only a strip, central line, and generic points without axes or provenance.
Decorative hero art carries no combinatorial claim.
A certificate-type and authority-boundary diagram is intrinsically vectorial and appropriate as SVG.
The entropy/coupling route should expose random-set variables, marginal frequencies, coupling operation, and the quantitative bound reached.
The half-way balance should be grounded in an incidence matrix or frequency bars so the threshold and double-counting identity are visible rather than merely metaphorical.
Known constants, special families, formal results, and the open one-half boundary should become an explicit status map.
The set nodes are useful, but the successor should state an exact union-closed example, show the relevant pairwise unions, and annotate element frequencies so the global witness question is visible.
The lattice lesson should use a verified finite join-semilattice with joins and irreducibles explicitly encoded rather than a cathedral motif.
Decorative hero art carries no gauge-theory or mass-gap claim.
The connection-curvature-holonomy lesson needs an explicit loop, parallel transport, return transformation, and infinitesimal curvature relation.
A vacuum-plus-positive-spectral-interval diagram is naturally vectorial when the spectrum and open interval (0,Delta) are labeled explicitly.
Three circles and short connector strokes do not visibly encode local gauge frames, their point-dependent transformations, or a connection comparing neighbouring frames.
The regulator-to-positivity-to-reconstruction-to-continuum obligation is a process diagram and is naturally suited to SVG if each obligation remains explicit.
